item.description: Engineered for sub-3 marathoners with high-resilience PEBA foam and a full carbon plate. MSRP $210, 184g weight, Q-KUNGFU PEBA.

item.title: Qiaodan Qiaodan LH600 2.0 (Long Haul) Specs & Review
item.description: Built for high weekly mileage, featuring protective dual-density foam, TPU arch support shank, and high-wear rubber outsole. MSRP $100, 235g weight, Q-KUNGFU Dual Foam.

item.title: Qiaodan Qiaodan Qinghong FREE Specs & Review
item.description: Ultra-soft step-in feel with max stack supercritical cushioning for easy recovery jogs, long walks, and all-day comfort. MSRP $85, 215g weight, Q-BOUND Soft.

item.title: Qiaodan Qiaodan Rapid 4.0 Specs & Review
item.description: Low-profile responsive trainer built for track intervals, tempo runs, and fast 5K-10K racing. MSRP $115, 185g weight, Q-KUNGFU Lite.

item.title: Qiaodan Qiaodan Thunder 1.0 Specs & Review
item.description: Delivers energetic impact absorption and smooth heel-to-toe transition for everyday training runs. MSRP $95, 225g weight, Q-BOUND PEBA Blend.

item.title: Qiaodan Qiaodan Wind 4.0 Specs & Review
item.description: Designed for daily miles in warm weather with high ventilation MONO mesh and energetic supercritical foam. MSRP $105, 205g weight, Q-KUNGFU Foam.

item.title: Nike Nike Alphafly 3 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Alphafly 3 is the pinnacle of marathon racing engineering. Featuring a continuous ZoomX foam midsole, dual forefoot Air Zoom pods, and a full-length Flyplate, it delivers unmatched propulsion and energy return for sub-3 marathoners. MSRP $285, 218g weight, ZoomX PEBA Foam.

item.title: Nike Nike Vaporfly 3 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Vaporfly 3 sets the global standard for lightweight racing performance. Weighing under 200g with 40mm of sculpted ZoomX foam and a full-length Flyplate, it offers snappy, featherweight speed from 5k to 42.2km. MSRP $260, 198g weight, ZoomX Foam.

item.title: Nike Nike Zoom Fly 6 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Zoom Fly 6 is redesigned from the ground up to be significantly lighter than previous iterations. Featuring ZoomX foam encased in a durable carrier with a full-length Flyplate, it is the perfect training companion to the Vaporfly and Alphafly. MSRP $170, 252g weight, ZoomX + SR-02 Carrier.

item.title: Nike Nike Pegasus 41 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Pegasus 41 introduces ReactX foam, offering 13% more energy return and a reduced carbon footprint. Paired with dual forefoot and heel Air Zoom units, it remains the world's most trusted daily running workhorse. MSRP $140, 283g weight, ReactX Foam.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 Specs & Review
item.description: The Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 4 is built for podium performances. Redesigned with a lighter forefoot rocker point, dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam, carbon ENERGYRODS 2.0, and Continental outsole rubber, it is trusted by major marathon winners worldwide. MSRP $250, 200g weight, Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero EVO SL Specs & Review
item.description: The Adidas Adizero EVO SL brings the pure, uninhibited bounce of full Lightstrike Pro super-foam to an affordable $150 non-plated trainer. Inspired by the record-breaking EVO Pro 1, it delivers effortless bounce and natural foot movement for daily workouts. MSRP $150, 224g weight, Full Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Boston 13 Specs & Review
item.description: The Adidas Adizero Boston 13 combines a top layer of Lightstrike Pro super-foam with a protective Lightstrike 2.0 base and glass-fiber ENERGYRODS. Built to handle 800+ km of grueling marathon training blocks. MSRP $160, 260g weight, Lightstrike Pro + Lightstrike 2.0.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Endorphin Elite 2 Specs & Review
item.description: The Saucony Endorphin Elite 2 features Saucony's most responsive PWRRUN HG super-foam paired with a slotted full-length carbon plate. Designed for aggressive forefoot runners seeking maximum turnover and toe-off spring. MSRP $275, 204g weight, PWRRUN HG.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Endorphin Pro 4 Specs & Review
item.description: The Saucony Endorphin Pro 4 features a dual-foam setup combining bouncy PWRRUN HG top foam with durable PWRRUN PB base foam and a full carbon plate. It provides a smooth, accessible super-shoe experience suitable for all foot strike patterns. MSRP $225, 212g weight, PWRRUN HG + PWRRUN PB.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Endorphin Speed 4 Specs & Review
item.description: The Saucony Endorphin Speed 4 is widely regarded as one of the best running shoes ever made. Featuring full PWRRUN PB super-foam and a flexible re-engineered winged nylon plate, it seamlessly handles daily mileage, tempo workouts, and races. MSRP $170, 233g weight, PWRRUN PB Foam.

item.title: ASICS ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 Specs & Review
item.description: The ASICS GEL-Kayano 31 is the gold standard for adaptive stability and max cushioning. Featuring FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO foam, rearfoot PureGEL™, and the 4D Guidance System™, it gently guides overpronating runners without harsh medial posts. MSRP $165, 303g weight, FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO + PureGEL™.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Prime X 2 Strung Specs & Review
item.description: The Adidas Adizero Prime X 2 Strung features a massive 50mm stack height, triple-layer Lightstrike Pro foam, and dual carbon infused plates inside a precision 3D-coded Strung upper. MSRP $300, 295g weight, Triple Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Takumi Sen 10 Specs & Review
item.description: Designed specifically for 5K to 10K racing and track interval workouts, the Takumi Sen 10 combines dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam with glass-fiber ENERGYRODS 2.0 in an ultra-agile 200g package. MSRP $180, 200g weight, Dual Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Supernova Rise Specs & Review
item.description: The Adidas Supernova Rise introduces Dreamstrike+ PEBA-based midsole foam paired with dense bottom Support Rods for effortless daily mileage and plush impact absorption. MSRP $140, 277g weight, Dreamstrike+.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero SL 2 Specs & Review
item.description: The Adizero SL 2 upgrades the budget lineup with a full-length Lightstrike Pro core encased in Lightstrike 2.0, creating one of the best value daily tempo trainers under $130. MSRP $130, 240g weight, Full Lightstrike Pro Core + Lightstrike 2.0.

item.title: Nike Nike Invincible 3 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Invincible 3 pairs a massive stack of full-length ZoomX foam with a wider base and Flyknit upper, offering unmatched plushness and leg-saving impact protection. MSRP $180, 310g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Nike Nike Pegasus Plus Specs & Review
item.description: Reviving the legendary Pegasus Turbo lineage, the Pegasus Plus features a full-length ZoomX midsole and iconic central racing stripe for energetic daily speed sessions. MSRP $180, 245g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Nike Nike Vomero 17 Specs & Review
item.description: The Nike Vomero 17 discards the air bag in favor of a dual-density midsole stacking top-tier ZoomX over durable Cushlon 3.0, delivering a silky smooth daily ride. MSRP $160, 280g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Triumph 22 Specs & Review
item.description: Saucony upgraded the Triumph 22 with full-length PWRRUN PB super-foam, bringing race-day PEBA cushioning and bounce to an ultra-plush daily trainer. MSRP $160, 286g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Ride 17 Specs & Review
item.description: The Ride 17 receives a major upgrade with full-length PWRRUN+ TPU foam, transforming Saucony’s staple workhorse into an energetic, responsive daily trainer. MSRP $140, 282g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Kinvara 15 Specs & Review
item.description: Staying true to lightweight minimalist performance, the Kinvara 15 offers a featherweight 198g build, low 4mm drop, and direct ground feel for tempo workouts. MSRP $130, 198g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Metaspeed Sky Paris Specs & Review
item.description: Weighing an astonishing 183g, the Metaspeed Sky Paris features ASICS’ newest FlyteFoam Blast TURBO+ PEBA foam and a full-length carbon plate tuned for stride-style marathoners. MSRP $250, 183g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Superblast 2 Specs & Review
item.description: The ASICS Superblast 2 inherits the FF TURBO+ PEBA foam from Paris race shoes, layering it over FF BLAST+ ECO to create the ultimate high-stack, non-plated daily workhorse. MSRP $220, 249g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Novablast 4 Specs & Review
item.description: Featuring geometric geometric trampoline outsole sculpting and eco-friendly FF BLAST+ ECO foam, the Novablast 4 remains the benchmark for fun, bouncy daily training. MSRP $140, 260g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Xtep Xtep 160X 6.0 PRO Specs & Review
item.description: The flagship Chinese super-shoe worn by elite marathon champions, featuring super-critical X-TEP ACE PEBA foam, a full-length spoon carbon plate, and CPU wear-resistant outsole. MSRP $260, 198g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Xtep Xtep 260 3.0 Specs & Review
item.description: Engineered as the ultimate workout partner for marathon training blocks, the Xtep 260 3.0 pairs a flexible Nylon plate with X-TEP ACE foam for responsive tempo runs. MSRP $130, 235g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Mizuno Mizuno Wave Rebellion Pro 2 Specs & Review
item.description: Featuring an aggressive 50mm heel stack with extreme heel cut-away, the Wave Rebellion Pro 2 forces an ultra-efficient forefoot strike backed by MIZUNO ENERZY LITE+ foam. MSRP $250, 215g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Mizuno Mizuno Wave Rider 28 Specs & Review
item.description: The 28th generation of Mizuno’s iconic Wave Rider introduces MIZUNO ENERZY NXT bio-based foam under the heel, giving the classic Wave Plate ride a softer, modern bounce. MSRP $140, 275g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: New Balance New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Elite v4 Specs & Review
item.description: Overhauling New Balance’s race tech, the SC Elite v4 features 100% PEBA FuelCell foam paired with a redesigned angular carbon Energy Arc plate for smooth marathon speed. MSRP $250, 237g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: New Balance New Balance FuelCell Rebel v4 Specs & Review
item.description: The Rebel v4 receives a geometric geometric makeover with a wider base, PEBA-blend FuelCell foam, and ultra-light 212g weight, making it a favorite non-plated speed trainer. MSRP $140, 212g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: New Balance New Balance Fresh Foam X 1080 v13 Specs & Review
item.description: The 1080 v13 redefines pillowy comfort with a reformulated Fresh Foam X midsole that delivers cloud-like shock absorption for recovery days and long daily miles. MSRP $165, 262g weight, Super-Foam Midsole.

item.title: Skechers Skechers GO WALK 7 Specs & Review
item.description: Designed specifically for walking and all-day standing comfort, the Skechers GO WALK 7 pairs lightweight ULTRA GO cushioning with high-rebound Hyper Pillar Technology and an Air-Cooled Goga Mat insole. MSRP $85, 235g weight, ULTRA GO + Hyper Pillars.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Bondi 8 Specs & Review
item.description: The HOKA Bondi 8 is the benchmark max-cushion walking and recovery shoe. Featuring a huge stack of lightweight EVA foam, plush memory foam collar, and smooth Meta-Rocker transition. MSRP $165, 307g weight, Lightweight Marshmallow EVA.

item.title: Brooks Brooks Ghost 16 Specs & Review
item.description: Upgraded with nitrogen-infused DNA LOFT v3 foam, the Brooks Ghost 16 delivers a softer, lighter, and more durable ride for millions of daily runners and walkers worldwide. MSRP $140, 269g weight, DNA LOFT v3 Nitrogen-Infused.

item.title: Nike Nike Motiva Specs & Review
item.description: Nike designed the Motiva from the ground up for walking, jog-walking, and active pacing. Featuring unique Comfortgroove bump outsole geometry that compresses to absorb every step. MSRP $110, 300g weight, Soft Cushion Foam + Comfortgroove Pods.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Clifton 9 Specs & Review
item.description: The Clifton 9 adds 3mm of stack height while shedding weight, delivering HOKA’s signature plush, effortless ride for daily training miles and long weekend runs. MSRP $145, 248g weight, Compression Molded EVA.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Mach 6 Specs & Review
item.description: Upgraded with a single-density supercritical EVA midsole and full rubber outsole coverage, the Mach 6 delivers snappy, responsive speed without needing a stiff carbon plate. MSRP $140, 232g weight, Supercritical EVA Foam.

item.title: Brooks Brooks Glycerin 21 Specs & Review
item.description: Brooks added 2mm of nitrogen-infused DNA LOFT v3 foam to the Glycerin 21, creating an ultra-soft, smooth-riding cushion flagship for long distance running and walking. MSRP $160, 278g weight, DNA LOFT v3 Nitrogen-Infused.

item.title: ASICS ASICS GT-2000 12 Specs & Review
item.description: Replacing harsh traditional medial posts, the GT-2000 12 uses a 3D Guidance System with wider basenet geometry, FlyteFoam Blast+ Eco foam, and PureGEL for smooth stability. MSRP $140, 270g weight, FF BLAST+ ECO & PureGEL.

item.title: Li-Ning Li-Ning Feidian 4.0 Ultra Specs & Review
item.description: The Feidian 4.0 Ultra features Li-Ning’s 4th generation supercritical BOOM PEBA foam, a full-length 3D curved carbon plate, and GCU ground control rubber for dominant 42K marathon racing. MSRP $280, 182g weight, Li-Ning BOOM PEBA 4.0.

item.title: Li-Ning Li-Ning Feidian 3.0 Ultra Specs & Review
item.description: The shoe that put Chinese super-shoes on the global map, the Feidian 3.0 Ultra combines high-rebound BOOM PEBA foam with a rigid carbon lever plate for marathon speed. MSRP $260, 190g weight, Li-Ning BOOM PEBA 3.0.

item.title: Nike Nike Vaporfly Next% 2 Specs & Review
item.description: The Vaporfly Next% 2 refined Nike’s legendary super-shoe formula with an engineered mesh upper while retaining the full-length ZoomX foam and full carbon Flyplate. MSRP $250, 196g weight, Nike ZoomX Foam.

item.title: Nike Nike Air Zoom Alphafly Next% 2 Specs & Review
item.description: The Alphafly Next% 2 added a thin layer of ZoomX under the dual Zoom Air pods and widened the heel, creating a more stable, highly cushioned marathon super-shoe. MSRP $275, 240g weight, Nike ZoomX + Dual Air Zoom Pods.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Adios Pro 3 Specs & Review
item.description: The Adios Pro 3 features a massive dual-layer stack of Lightstrike Pro foam, Continental rubber outsole, and full-length carbon ENERGYRODS 2.0 for smooth, non-fatiguing marathon cruising. MSRP $250, 218g weight, Dual Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Adizero Boston 12 Specs & Review
item.description: The Boston 12 restored the series to greatness, layering top Lightstrike Pro foam over durable Lightstrike 2.0 with glass-fiber ENERGYRODS 2.0 for fast tempo workouts and long runs. MSRP $160, 267g weight, Lightstrike Pro + Lightstrike 2.0.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Superblast (v1) Specs & Review
item.description: The shoe that launched the non-plated super-trainer category, combining a massive 45.5mm stack of FF BLAST TURBO PEBA foam over FF BLAST+ for effortless daily long run miles. MSRP $220, 239g weight, FF BLAST™ TURBO & FF BLAST™ PLUS.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Novablast 3 Specs & Review
item.description: Shedding 22g over v2, the Novablast 3 featured a full-length FF BLAST+ foam midsole with geometric origami sculpting for a fun, bouncy daily training experience. MSRP $140, 252g weight, FF BLAST™ PLUS.

item.title: Saucony Saucony Endorphin Speed 3 Specs & Review
item.description: Widely regarded as one of the best running shoes ever made, the Speed 3 introduced a winged S-curve nylon plate inside full-length PWRRUN PB foam for versatile, smooth speed. MSRP $170, 229g weight, PWRRUN PB Midsole.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Mach 5 Specs & Review
item.description: Combining a soft top layer of PROFLY+ foam with a rubberized EVA bottom layer, the Mach 5 delivered a super-lightweight, snappy non-plated ride for workouts and daily miles. MSRP $140, 232g weight, PROFLY+ Dual-Density Foam.

item.title: Salomon Salomon Speedcross 6 Specs & Review
item.description: The Salomon Speedcross 6 is the gold standard for technical trail running and mud. Featuring deep 5.5mm chevron Contagrip lugs, Quicklace system, and Sensifit foot wrap. MSRP $150, 298g weight, EnergyCell+ High-Rebound EVA.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Speedgoat 6 Specs & Review
item.description: Named after Karl "Speedgoat" Meltzer, the Speedgoat 6 combines a lighter CMEVA midsole stack with Vibram Megagrip Traction Lugs for supreme cushion and mountain trail stability. MSRP $155, 278g weight, Compression Molded EVA.

item.title: Nike Nike Pegasus Trail 5 Specs & Review
item.description: Upgraded with high-energy ReactX foam and Nike’s new All-Terrain Compound (ATC) rubber, the Pegasus Trail 5 seamlessly transitions from city pavement to forest singletrack. MSRP $150, 286g weight, Nike ReactX Foam.

item.title: Altra Altra Lone Peak 8 Specs & Review
item.description: The cult-classic trail shoe loved by thru-hikers and trail runners. Featuring Altra’s Zero Drop platform, roomy FootShape™ toe box, and MaxTrac sticky rubber lugs. MSRP $150, 303g weight, Altra EGO™ Midsole.

item.title: On Running On Cloud 5 Specs & Review
item.description: Swiss-engineered for daily wear, travel, and walking. The On Cloud 5 features signature CloudTec pods in Zero-Gravity foam, Speedboard transition plate, and hands-free speed lacing. MSRP $140, 250g weight, CloudTec® Zero-Gravity Foam.

item.title: On Running On Cloudmonster 2 Specs & Review
item.description: On’s biggest CloudTec pods ever. The Cloudmonster 2 layers dual-density Helion super-foam around a reworked nylon Speedboard for maximum energy return and giant stack cushion. MSRP $180, 295g weight, Dual-Density Helion™ Super-Foam.

item.title: ASICS ASICS GEL-Nimbus 26 Specs & Review
item.description: The GEL-Nimbus 26 upgrades ASICS’ flagship max-cushion trainer with HYBRID ASICSGRIP outsole rubber and FF BLAST+ ECO foam for cloud-like shock absorption on long runs and walks. MSRP $160, 304g weight, FF BLAST™ PLUS ECO & PureGEL.

item.title: HOKA HOKA Cielo X1 Specs & Review
item.description: HOKA’s fastest, most aggressive marathon super-shoe yet. The Cielo X1 combines ultra-bouncy dual-layer PEBA foam with a winged carbon fiber plate and deep dynamic rocker cuts. MSRP $275, 264g weight, Dual-Layer PEBA Super-Foam.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Metaspeed Edge Paris Specs & Review
item.description: Designed specifically for cadence runners who increase speed by taking more steps per minute. Features a spoon-shaped angled carbon plate and ultra-light FF TURBO+ PEBA foam. MSRP $250, 185g weight, FF TURBO™ PLUS PEBA.

item.title: ASICS ASICS Magic Speed 4 Specs & Review
item.description: The Magic Speed 4 received a huge upgrade, adding a pod of FF TURBO PEBA foam under the forefoot along with a full-length carbon plate for snappy, accessible tempo workouts. MSRP $180, 242g weight, FF BLAST™ PLUS & FF TURBO™ Pod.

item.title: Adidas Adidas Terrex Agravic Speed Ultra Specs & Review
item.description: Designed to win Western States 100 and UTMB. Combines a high stack of dual-layer Lightstrike Pro foam with carbon-infused ENERGYRODS and Continental rubber on trails. MSRP $220, 270g weight, Dual Lightstrike Pro.

item.title: Brooks Brooks Adrenaline GTS 23 Specs & Review
item.description: The best-selling stability shoe in North America. Features GuideRails® holistic support system to keep excess knee movement in check alongside DNA LOFT v2 cushioning. MSRP $140, 286g weight, DNA LOFT v2 Cushioning.

item.title: Nike Nike Ultrafly Specs & Review
item.description: Nike’s ultimate carbon trail super-shoe. Encases bouncy ZoomX foam inside a protective fabric wrap, paired with a full carbon Flyplate and Vibram Megagrip outsole. MSRP $260, 289g weight, Nike ZoomX Foam.
